notes: Seed entries for reusable AskCrystal metaobjects.
These entries are safe defaults for storefront education and agent grounding.
Operational claims should stay generic unless verified by store operations.

fields.name: Amethyst
fields.short_meaning: A calming purple quartz traditionally associated with quieting mental noise, dreamwork, and intuitive reflection.
fields.care_notes: Avoid harsh chemicals and prolonged direct sunlight. Clean gently with a soft dry cloth.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with selenite for clearing and rose quartz for emotional softness.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Rose Quartz
fields.short_meaning: A gentle pink quartz traditionally linked with self-love, emotional softness, and heart-centered repair.
fields.care_notes: Keep away from harsh chemicals and extended sun exposure. Wipe with a soft cloth after wear.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with amethyst for calm or clear quartz for amplifying a heart intention.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Black Tourmaline
fields.short_meaning: A grounding black crystal traditionally used for energetic boundaries, protection, and steadiness.
fields.care_notes: Avoid soaking. Clean with a soft dry cloth and store separately from softer stones.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with clear quartz for focus or selenite for regular energetic clearing.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Clear Quartz
fields.short_meaning: A versatile crystal traditionally associated with clarity, amplification, and intention-setting.
fields.care_notes: Clean gently with a soft cloth. Avoid impact against harder surfaces.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs with most crystals when you want to clarify or strengthen an intention.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Citrine
fields.short_meaning: A warm golden quartz traditionally connected with confidence, creative momentum, and abundance mindset.
fields.care_notes: Avoid prolonged direct sunlight to protect color. Clean with a soft dry cloth.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with green aventurine for opportunity work or tiger's eye for practical confidence.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Selenite
fields.short_meaning: A luminous crystal traditionally used for cleansing, spaciousness, and creating a calm ritual field.
fields.care_notes: Keep dry. Selenite is soft and can dissolve or flake with water exposure.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with almost any crystal as a cleansing companion.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice. Keep selenite dry.

fields.name: Moonstone
fields.short_meaning: A softly luminous feldspar traditionally associated with emotional rhythm, intuition, and new beginnings.
fields.care_notes: Avoid harsh chemicals and hard impact. Wipe gently with a soft cloth after wear.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with rose quartz for emotional gentleness or amethyst for dreamwork.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Lapis Lazuli
fields.short_meaning: A deep blue stone traditionally linked with truth, inner authority, and thoughtful communication.
fields.care_notes: Avoid soaking, ultrasonic cleaners, and harsh chemicals. Clean with a soft dry cloth.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with clear quartz for clarity or amethyst for reflective insight.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Malachite
fields.short_meaning: A rich green stone traditionally associated with emotional courage, protection through change, and heart-led transformation.
fields.care_notes: Avoid soaking, harsh chemicals, and abrasive contact. Clean gently with a soft dry cloth.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with lapis lazuli for clearer expression or pearl for a softer heart-centered tone.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Turquoise
fields.short_meaning: A blue-green stone traditionally connected with honest communication, calm protection, and an easier flow between heart and voice.
fields.care_notes: Keep away from harsh chemicals, perfume, and prolonged water exposure. Wipe gently after wear.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with lapis lazuli for thoughtful communication or pearl when the energy needs to stay softer and more soothing.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Tiger's Eye
fields.short_meaning: A golden-brown stone traditionally associated with courage, grounded action, and practical confidence.
fields.care_notes: Clean with a soft cloth and avoid harsh chemicals. Store separately to prevent scratches.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with citrine for momentum or black tourmaline for stronger boundaries.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Green Aventurine
fields.short_meaning: A green quartzite traditionally connected with opportunity, optimism, and gentle heart renewal.
fields.care_notes: Clean gently with a soft cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals and abrasive surfaces.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with citrine for abundance work or rose quartz for heart softness.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Amazonite
fields.short_meaning: A soft blue-green feldspar traditionally associated with calm communication, perspective, and emotional steadiness.
fields.care_notes: Clean gently with a soft dry cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals and prolonged soaking.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with clear quartz for cleaner focus or moonstone for a softer emotional tone.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Prehnite
fields.short_meaning: A pale green stone traditionally associated with emotional clarity, gentle intuition, and a calmer heart-led perspective.
fields.care_notes: Clean gently with a soft cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals, hard impact, and prolonged soaking around metal findings.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with citrine for brighter momentum or clear quartz for a cleaner, more spacious intention.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Blue Onyx
fields.short_meaning: A cool blue chalcedony traditionally associated with calm speech, emotional steadiness, and composed reflection.
fields.care_notes: Clean gently with a soft dry cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals, prolonged soaking, and abrasive storage.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with clear quartz for clarity or moonstone for a softer emotional rhythm.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Baroque Pearl
fields.short_meaning: An organically shaped pearl traditionally associated with emotional softness, natural confidence, and imperfect beauty.
fields.care_notes: Pearl is delicate. Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth after wear and avoid perfume, harsh chemicals, soaking, and abrasive storage.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with agate for grounded warmth or clear quartz when the intention is soft clarity.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice. Remove if the piece feels tight or uncomfortable.

fields.name: Smoky Quartz
fields.short_meaning: A translucent brown quartz traditionally associated with grounding, release, and calm practical focus.
fields.care_notes: Clean with a soft dry cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals, hard impact, and prolonged direct sunlight.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with black tourmaline for steadier grounding or citrine for practical confidence.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Sterling Silver
fields.short_meaning: A bright precious metal traditionally associated with clarity, refinement, and everyday ritual polish.
fields.care_notes: Wipe with a soft polishing cloth after wear and keep away from perfumes, chlorinated water, and abrasive surfaces.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with clear quartz, moonstone, and blue stones when a cooler, quieter finish is desired.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice. Remove if you have a known silver sensitivity.

fields.name: Copper
fields.short_meaning: A warm conductive metal traditionally associated with circulation of intention, creative confidence, and everyday energetic connection.
fields.care_notes: Keep dry when possible. Wipe with a soft cloth after wear and store away from harsh chemicals or abrasive surfaces.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with clear quartz for clarity, citrine for momentum, or rose quartz for a softer heart-led intention.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice. Avoid if you have a known copper sensitivity.

fields.name: Agate
fields.short_meaning: A banded chalcedony traditionally associated with steady grounding, emotional balance, and calm focus.
fields.care_notes: Clean gently with a soft dry cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals, hard impact, and prolonged soaking.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with black tourmaline for stronger grounding or rose quartz for a softer emotional reset.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.title: Sleep Release Ritual
steps: Hold the crystal for three slow breaths
Name one thought you are ready to release
Place the crystal near your bedside before sleep
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only.

fields.title: Self-Love Reset Ritual
steps: Place one hand over your heart
Hold the crystal and take three steady breaths
Speak one kind sentence to yourself
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only.

fields.title: Boundary Setting Ritual
steps: Hold the crystal near your lower body
Name one boundary you are choosing today
Carry or place the crystal where you need steadiness
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only.

fields.name: Elise Hartmann
fields.short_bio: Elise works with quiet symmetry and soft contrast, shaping premium crystal pieces that feel calm, precise, and easy to live with.
fields.signature_style: Balanced bead rhythm, pale stones, brushed metal details, and restrained compositions that keep the material visible.
fields.artist_note: Use when a premium product needs a composed, meditative point of view without feeling ornate.

fields.name: Naomi Watanabe
fields.short_bio: Naomi brings a spare, tactile approach to crystal styling, favoring pieces that feel intentional rather than decorative.
fields.signature_style: Clean spacing, translucent stones, subtle asymmetry, and details that make everyday ritual feel considered.
fields.artist_note: Best for products where restraint, texture, and a gentle sense of order are part of the appeal.

profile_image.alt: Black and white portrait of Naomi Watanabe

fields.name: Mara Kessler
fields.short_bio: Mara studies color temperature and stone variation, building pieces that feel warm, personal, and quietly expressive.
fields.signature_style: Rose tones, soft gold accents, rounded silhouettes, and gentle transitions between crystal textures.
fields.artist_note: Use for premium gifts and heart-led pieces that need warmth without slipping into sentimentality.

profile_image.alt: Black and white portrait of Mara Kessler

fields.name: Daniel Moreau
fields.short_bio: Daniel approaches crystal objects through proportion and utility, giving grounding pieces a quiet architectural presence.
fields.signature_style: Strong contrast, matte black stones, measured spacing, and clean silhouettes that feel steady on the body.
fields.artist_note: Use for grounding or protection products where structure, weight, and restraint matter most.

fields.name: Priya Nair
fields.short_bio: Priya focuses on pieces that move easily between work, ritual, and gifting, with a preference for clarity and wearable polish.
fields.signature_style: Fine-scale details, luminous stones, warm metal notes, and compositions that look refined without becoming formal.
fields.artist_note: Best for premium pieces tied to momentum, visibility, and everyday confidence.

fields.name: Sofia Lind
fields.short_bio: Sofia favors pale palettes and practical details, creating pieces that feel light, calm, and quietly durable.
fields.signature_style: Nordic minimalism, cool-toned stones, smooth finishes, and a preference for honest material contrast.
fields.artist_note: Use when a product should feel minimal, fresh, and easy to pair with a quiet daily routine.

fields.name: Amina Darzi
fields.short_bio: Amina works with saturated color and tactile rhythm, bringing a collected, travel-worn sensibility to expressive pieces.
fields.signature_style: Deep blues, warm metals, layered stone textures, and details that make premium pieces feel found rather than staged.
fields.artist_note: Use for products that need color, presence, and a grounded sense of personal style.

fields.name: Julian Becker
fields.short_bio: Julian builds from simple geometry and visible structure, giving crystal pieces a practical, modern edge.
fields.signature_style: Modular spacing, dark grounding stones, crisp metal contrast, and pieces that feel direct rather than mystical.
fields.artist_note: Use for clean, contemporary products where the story should feel practical and deliberate.

fields.name: Mei Chen
fields.short_bio: Mei designs for small daily gestures, choosing stones and finishes that feel personal at close range.
fields.signature_style: Delicate scale, thoughtful negative space, soft reflective surfaces, and details that reward a second look.
fields.artist_note: Best for pieces that need intimacy, softness, and a quietly personal gift story.

fields.name: Rafael Ortega
fields.short_bio: Rafael works with movement, contrast, and small flashes of brightness, creating pieces that feel confident without being loud.
fields.signature_style: Polished dark stones, warm highlights, rhythmic repetition, and wearable forms with a subtle sense of motion.
fields.artist_note: Use for premium products that need energy, contrast, and a little visual momentum.
